depicts: Two strokes splitting away from each other, like something being divided in two.
commentary: 八 (bā, eight) — Two strokes split away from each other, like something being divided in two. The widening gap is the picture: one thing pulling apart.

depicts: An unborn baby curled up inside a womb that wraps around it like a bundle.
commentary: 包 (bāo, to wrap; bag) — A baby lies curled inside a womb that wraps around it like a bundle. The wrapping shape around the curled form is what carries the meaning.

depicts: The green calyx of a flower: a small cup of pointed sepals on a stem that once held a bloom.
commentary: 不 (bù, not; no) — The picture is a flower's green calyx: a small cup of pointed sepals on a stem that once held a bloom. Look for the pointed cup on its stem.

depicts: A cart seen from above: two big wheels, an axle, a shaft, and the box of the cart between them.
commentary: 车 (chē, cart; vehicle) — A cart seen from above: two big wheels, an axle and a shaft, with the cart's box between them. The wheels and axle frame the whole character.

depicts: A cloth sack bulging in the middle, both ends tied shut with cord.
commentary: 东 (dōng, east; sack) — A cloth sack bulging in the middle, both ends tied shut with cord. The tied ends above and below the bulge are the detail to hold onto.

depicts: A small toddler: a big round head with a soft spot on top and little legs below.
commentary: 儿 (ér, child; son) — A small toddler: a big round head with a soft spot on top and little legs below. The oversized head is what makes it a child.

depicts: Two boat hulls lashed side by side into a raft, their bows tied together.
commentary: 方 (fāng, square; raft) — Two boat hulls lashed side by side into a raft, their bows tied together. The paired hulls tied at the front form the picture.

depicts: A bird in flight, wings spread wide and tail feathers streaming behind it.
commentary: 飞 (fēi, to fly) — A bird in flight, wings spread wide and tail feathers streaming behind. The spread wings and trailing tail say movement through air.

depicts: A forked pole weapon: a long shaft splitting into two prongs at the top.
commentary: 干 (gān, shield; forked weapon) — A forked pole weapon: a long shaft splitting into two prongs at the top. The split at the top of the shaft is the key detail.

depicts: A tall watchtower: a roofed building with a doorway, raised on a high platform.
commentary: 高 (gāo, tall; high) — A tall watchtower: a roofed building with a doorway, raised on a high platform. Everything sits up high — that height is the meaning.

depicts: An ancient carpenter's square: a thick I-shaped measuring tool with notched ends.
commentary: 工 (gōng, work; tool) — An ancient carpenter's square: a thick I-shaped measuring tool with notched ends. The two horizontal bars joined by a vertical are the tool itself.

depicts: A round fruit hanging at the very top of a tree, trunk and branches below it.
commentary: 果 (guǒ, fruit) — A round fruit hangs at the very top of a tree, with trunk and branches below it. Find the round shape sitting on top — that is the fruit.

depicts: A whirlpool: two concentric squared spirals turning around a centre.
commentary: 回 (huí, to turn around) — A whirlpool: two concentric squared spirals turning around a centre. The nested turning shapes show the motion of turning back.

depicts: A central flame tongue rising up with two smaller flames flickering out at its sides.
commentary: 火 (huǒ, fire) — A central flame tongue rises up with two smaller flames flickering out at its sides. The tall middle flame flanked by sparks is the fire.

depicts: A tall gatehouse on a high mound: a roofed building raised on an earthen platform.
commentary: 京 (jīng, capital) — A tall gatehouse on a high mound: a roofed building raised on an earthen platform. The building lifted high on its mound gives the grand, capital feel.

depicts: A bent arm: upper arm and forearm folded at the elbow, reaching out.
commentary: 九 (jiǔ, nine) — A bent arm: upper arm and forearm folded at the elbow, reaching out. The fold at the elbow is the shape to remember.

depicts: An open mouth: one simple rounded square outline, nothing more.
commentary: 口 (kǒu, mouth) — An open mouth: one simple rounded square outline, nothing more. The plain empty opening is the whole picture.

depicts: A stalk of wheat: a vertical stem with grains and long awns (bristles) at its head.
commentary: 来 (lái, wheat; to come) — A stalk of wheat: a vertical stem with grains and long awns at its head. The bristly head on the stem is the wheat.

depicts: A horse in profile facing left: crested mane, one visible eye, four legs and a long flowing tail.
commentary: 马 (mǎ, horse) — A horse in profile facing left: crested mane, one visible eye, four legs and a long flowing tail. The mane on the neck and the streaming tail mark it as a horse.

depicts: A tuft of hair: fine strands bending over together from a root.
commentary: 毛 (máo, hair; fur) — A tuft of hair: fine strands bending over together from a root. The strands curving over in one direction give it the soft look of hair.

depicts: A double-leaf gate: two door panels hanging in a frame.
commentary: 门 (mén, door; gate) — A double-leaf gate: two door panels hanging in a frame. The pair of panels side by side is the gate.

depicts: Loose grains of rice as small dots clustered around a central husk on a stem.
commentary: 米 (mǐ, rice) — Loose grains of rice as small dots clustered around a central husk on a stem. The scattered dots are the grains.

depicts: A human face drawn full-on: an outline of a face with one eye in the middle.
commentary: 面 (miàn, face) — A human face drawn full-on: an outline of a face with one eye in the middle. The single eye inside the outline anchors the face.

depicts: A bull's head seen from the front: two curved horns, ears at the sides, and a muzzle below.
commentary: 牛 (niú, ox; cow) — A bull's head seen from the front: two curved horns, ears at the sides and a muzzle below. The horns rising at the top are the first thing to find.

depicts: A woman kneeling in profile with her arms folded in front of her body.
commentary: 女 (nǚ, woman) — A woman kneeling in profile with her arms folded in front of her body. The kneeling posture and folded arms make the figure.

depicts: Three long wavy horizontal bands stacked one above another, like layers of drifting cloud or steam.
commentary: 气 (qì, air; vapour) — Three long wavy horizontal bands stacked one above another, like layers of drifting cloud or steam. The layered waves are air itself, rising and drifting.

depicts: A person in profile: a bent back, one arm hanging down, and legs mid-stride.
commentary: 人 (rén, person) — A person in profile: a bent back, one arm hanging down and legs mid-stride. Two strokes are enough — a body leaning into a step.

depicts: A ring for the sun: a circle with a short mark in its centre.
commentary: 日 (rì, sun) — A ring for the sun: a circle with a short mark in its centre. The mark inside the ring is what makes it the sun and not just a circle.

depicts: A cut of meat: a chunk with the grain of flesh and fat drawn as lines inside it.
commentary: 肉 (ròu, meat; flesh) — A cut of meat: a chunk with the grain of flesh and fat drawn as lines inside it. The lines inside the chunk show the texture of flesh.

depicts: Three mountain peaks rising from one ground line, the middle peak the tallest.
commentary: 山 (shān, mountain) — Three mountain peaks rise from one ground line, the middle peak the tallest. The three upright peaks on a shared base are the mountains.

depicts: A person in profile with a big swollen belly: a pregnant body.
commentary: 身 (shēn, body) — A person in profile with a big swollen belly: a pregnant body. The rounded belly is the detail the picture is built around.

depicts: A young shoot with two new leaves pushing up out of a line of soil.
commentary: 生 (shēng, to grow; to be born) — A young shoot with two new leaves pushes up out of a line of soil. New growth breaking the surface is the meaning in action.

depicts: An open hand with fingers spread, palm facing the viewer.
commentary: 手 (shǒu, hand) — An open hand with fingers spread, palm facing the viewer. The spread fingers at the top are unmistakably a hand.

depicts: A main stream flowing down the middle with smaller streams splashing off to both sides.
commentary: 水 (shuǐ, water) — A main stream flows down the middle with smaller streams splashing off to both sides. The central flow with splashes on each side is water in motion.

depicts: A fishing net hung open: a straight top edge with a mesh of crossed lines below.
commentary: 网 (wǎng, net; web) — A fishing net hung open: a straight top edge with a mesh of crossed lines below. The criss-cross mesh under the top bar is the net.

depicts: A standing person seen from the front with decorative tattoo lines drawn across the chest.
commentary: 文 (wén, script; pattern) — A standing person seen from the front with decorative tattoo lines drawn across the chest. The patterned lines on the chest are the point — pattern itself.

depicts: A bird settled in its nest at sunset: a round nest with a bird resting inside it.
commentary: 西 (xī, west) — A bird settled in its nest at sunset: a round nest with a bird resting inside it. The bird home for the night points to the setting sun and the west.

depicts: Three tiny grains of sand lying side by side.
commentary: 小 (xiǎo, small) — Three tiny grains of sand lying side by side. Their tininess is the whole message: small things, drawn small.

depicts: A kneeling person drawn with a greatly oversized head — the head is the whole point of the picture.
commentary: 页 (yè, page; head) — A kneeling person drawn with a greatly oversized head. The head swollen out of proportion is the whole point of the picture.

depicts: A robe with wide sleeves: a collar crossing at the neck, sleeves hanging at both sides, and a skirt below.
commentary: 衣 (yī, clothes) — A robe with wide sleeves: a collar crossing at the neck, sleeves hanging at both sides and a skirt below. The crossing collar and hanging sleeves make it a garment.

depicts: A line of sky at the top, a band of cloud under it, and four raindrops falling through the air.
commentary: 雨 (yǔ, rain) — A line of sky at the top, a band of cloud under it, and four raindrops falling through the air. The drops falling beneath the cloud band are the rain.

depicts: A slim crescent moon with its horns pointing up and a short stroke inside the crescent.
commentary: 月 (yuè, moon) — A slim crescent moon with its horns pointing up and a short stroke inside the crescent. The thin crescent shape separates it from the round sun.

depicts: A baby with a big head and waving arms, its lower body wrapped in swaddling clothes.
commentary: 子 (zǐ, child) — A baby with a big head and waving arms, its lower body wrapped in swaddling clothes. The big head and little waving arms say infant.

depicts: A waist belt with a sash hanging down the front and small objects dangling from its loops.
commentary: 带 (dài, belt; sash) — A waist belt with a sash hanging down the front and small objects dangling from its loops. The dangling sash and objects hang from the belt line.

depicts: A length of thread with a knot tied at both ends, hanging down.
commentary: 冬 (dōng, winter) — A length of thread with a knot tied at both ends, hanging down. The knots closing both ends give a sense of things tied up and finished.

depicts: A beard: strands of hair hanging down from a chin.
commentary: 而 (ér, and; but) — A beard: strands of hair hanging down from a chin. The hanging strands below the chin line are the beard.

depicts: A house built under a cliff: a wide sloping roof over an open front.
commentary: 广 (guǎng, wide; shelter) — A house built under a cliff: a wide sloping roof over an open front. The broad roof sheltering an open space is the picture.

depicts: A length of cord bent into a squared-off coil, partly unwound.
commentary: 己 (jǐ, self) — A length of cord bent into a squared-off coil, partly unwound. The bent, coiling line is the whole form.

depicts: A person standing with legs crossed at the ankles and arms folded across the chest.
commentary: 交 (jiāo, to cross; intersect) — A person standing with legs crossed at the ankles and arms folded across the chest. Crossed limbs top and bottom are the crossing the character names.

depicts: An axe seen from the side: a broad curved blade mounted on a handle.
commentary: 斤 (jīn, axe; unit of weight) — An axe seen from the side: a broad curved blade mounted on a handle. The curved blade edge is the working part to spot.

depicts: An ancient plough: a long curved handle coming down to a forked share that bites into the soil.
commentary: 力 (lì, strength; plough) — An ancient plough: a long curved handle coming down to a forked share that bites into the soil. The share digging into the ground is where the strength goes.

depicts: An eye drawn on its side: an outline with the pupil as a mark in the middle.
commentary: 目 (mù, eye) — An eye drawn on its side: an outline with the pupil as a mark in the middle. The pupil centred in the outline makes it an eye at a glance.

depicts: A perched bird in profile: crested head with beak and eye, folded wing, tail feathers and clawed feet.
commentary: 鸟 (niǎo, bird) — A perched bird in profile: crested head with beak and eye, folded wing, tail feathers and clawed feet. The beak, crest and claws give the full bird.

depicts: A log split lengthwise: one half of a trunk with its flat split face forward.
commentary: 片 (piàn, slice; slab) — A log split lengthwise: one half of a trunk with its flat split face forward. The flat face shows it is a cut slice, not a whole log.

depicts: A sacrificial stand seen from the front: a flat top carried on legs, like a small altar table.
commentary: 且 (qiě, moreover; stand) — A sacrificial stand seen from the front: a flat top carried on legs, like a small altar table. The flat top on legs is the stand.

depicts: A sacrificial altar: a table-like stand with offerings hanging from its top board.
commentary: 示 (shì, to show; altar) — A sacrificial altar: a table-like stand with offerings hanging from its top board. The offerings hanging from the top mark it as an altar.

depicts: A snake with its head raised: a small head and a very long body curving down into a drooping tail.
commentary: 它 (tā, it) — A snake with its head raised: a small head and a very long body curving down into a drooping tail. The small head on the long curving body is the snake.

depicts: A scorpion: a round body with claws at the front, jointed legs at the sides and a curved sting tail.
commentary: 万 (wàn, ten thousand) — A scorpion: a round body with claws at the front, jointed legs at the sides and a curved sting tail. The claws in front and the sting curving behind identify it.

depicts: A heart organ: a rounded sac with the great vessels curving out of its top.
commentary: 心 (xīn, heart) — A heart organ: a rounded sac with the great vessels curving out of its top. The curved vessels on top of the sac are the anatomical giveaway.

depicts: A crossroads seen from above: one road crossing another at right angles.
commentary: 行 (xíng, to go; to walk) — A crossroads seen from above: one road crossing another at right angles. Where the two roads cross is where walking and travel happen.

depicts: A person standing with both hands planted on their waist, elbows out.
commentary: 要 (yào, to want; important) — A person standing with both hands planted on their waist, elbows out. The hands-on-waist stance is the picture's whole posture.

depicts: A right hand seen from the side, its fingers curled as if gripping.
commentary: 又 (yòu, again; hand) — A right hand seen from the side, its fingers curled as if gripping. The curled fingers show a hand in the act of holding.

depicts: A fish in profile: triangular head with mouth and eye, a scaled body, fins, and a forked tail.
commentary: 鱼 (yú, fish) — A fish in profile: triangular head with mouth and eye, a scaled body, fins and a forked tail. Head, scales and forked tail leave no doubt it is a fish.

depicts: A cloud curling over on itself: a straight stroke on top with a spiral swirl hanging below.
commentary: 云 (yún, cloud) — A cloud curling over on itself: a straight stroke on top with a spiral swirl hanging below. The swirl underneath is the cloud rolling.

depicts: An old man with very long hair streaming behind him, leaning on a walking staff.
commentary: 长 (zhǎng, to grow; long) — An old man with very long hair streaming behind him, leaning on a walking staff. The streaming long hair carries both age and length.

depicts: An oil lamp on a stand: a stem rising to a shallow dish with a single flame burning on top.
commentary: 主 (zhǔ, master; lamp) — An oil lamp on a stand: a stem rising to a shallow dish with a single flame burning on top. The one flame at the very top is the focal point.

depicts: A nose seen from the front: the bridge, the two nostrils and the wings of the nose.
commentary: 自 (zì, self; originally nose) — A nose seen from the front: the bridge, the two nostrils and the wings of the nose. The two nostrils at the bottom are the detail to find.

depicts: A steep cliff face: one long slope dropping away from a top edge.
commentary: 厂 (chǎng, factory; cliff) — A steep cliff face: one long slope dropping away from a top edge. The single dropping slope is the cliff.

depicts: A person seen from the front, standing tall with arms stretched wide and legs apart.
commentary: 大 (dà, big) — A person seen from the front, standing tall with arms stretched wide and legs apart. A human figure spread as wide as it can go is how the picture says big.

depicts: A curved single-edged knife blade with a short handle.
commentary: 刀 (dāo, knife) — A curved single-edged knife blade with a short handle. The curve of the blade is the cutting edge to notice.

depicts: Three young grass shoots sprouting in a row from a single ground stem.
commentary: 丰 (fēng, abundant) — Three young grass shoots sprouting in a row from a single ground stem. Shoot after shoot rising together gives the feel of plenty.

depicts: A person standing squarely on a ground line, seen from the front.
commentary: 立 (lì, to stand) — A person standing squarely on a ground line, seen from the front. Feet planted on the ground line: standing, plain and simple.

depicts: A dragon rearing up: a horned head with open jaws at the top of a long serpentine body ending in a tail.
commentary: 龙 (lóng, dragon) — A dragon rearing up: a horned head with open jaws at the top of a long serpentine body ending in a tail. The horned head and open jaws crown the winding body.

depicts: A kneeling woman shown by her two breasts, drawn as two dots inside her body's outline.
commentary: 母 (mǔ, mother) — A kneeling woman shown by her two breasts, drawn as two dots inside her body's outline. The two dots inside the outline are the meaning.

depicts: A tree: a straight trunk, branches spreading up and out, and roots spreading down into the ground.
commentary: 木 (mù, tree; wood) — A tree: a straight trunk, branches spreading up and out, and roots spreading down into the ground. Branches above and roots below balance around the trunk.

depicts: Three heads of grain standing in a row, all grown to exactly the same height.
commentary: 齐 (qí, even; level) — Three heads of grain standing in a row, all grown to exactly the same height. Their tops lining up evenly is the whole idea.

depicts: A measuring dipper: a deep cup with a long flat handle sticking out to one side.
commentary: 升 (shēng, to rise; measuring ladle) — A measuring dipper: a deep cup with a long flat handle sticking out to one side. The cup with its handle is the ladle.

depicts: A rounded boulder lying at the foot of a cliff overhang.
commentary: 石 (shí, stone; rock) — A rounded boulder lying at the foot of a cliff overhang. The boulder tucked under the overhang is the stone.

depicts: A head with a full mass of hair on top, hair strokes rising above the face.
commentary: 首 (shǒu, head) — A head with a full mass of hair on top, hair strokes rising above the face. The hair crowning the head is the feature that stands out.

depicts: A mound of earth heaped up on a flat ground line, like a small altar of soil.
commentary: 土 (tǔ, earth; soil) — A mound of earth heaped up on a flat ground line, like a small altar of soil. The heap rising from the ground line is the earth itself.

depicts: An elephant in profile: a huge ear, a long trunk curling down, tusks, a massive body and four column legs.
commentary: 象 (xiàng, elephant) — An elephant in profile: a huge ear, a long trunk curling down, tusks, a massive body and four column legs. The long trunk curling down is unmistakably an elephant.

depicts: A sheep's head seen from the front: two curling horns, ears, and a pointed face below.
commentary: 羊 (yáng, sheep; goat) — A sheep's head seen from the front: two curling horns, ears and a pointed face below. The curling horns at the top frame the face.

depicts: An arrow flying downward and striking a horizontal ground line point-first.
commentary: 至 (zhì, to arrive) — An arrow flying downward and striking a horizontal ground line point-first. Arrival is shown the moment the arrow lands.

depicts: A whole leg: a circle for the kneecap at the top, the shin below, and a foot at the bottom.
commentary: 足 (zú, foot) — A whole leg: a circle for the kneecap at the top, the shin below and a foot at the bottom. Follow it down — kneecap, shin, foot.

depicts: A big thick snake coiled up, its head raised at one end of the coil.
commentary: 巴 (bā, used in compounds) — A big thick snake coiled up, its head raised at one end of the coil. The thick coil with the head lifted is the snake.

depicts: A cowrie shell: an oval shell with a serrated slit running down its middle.
commentary: 贝 (bèi, shell; cowrie) — A cowrie shell: an oval shell with a serrated slit running down its middle. The toothed slit down the centre is the cowrie's signature.

depicts: A snake rearing up: a triangular head with an eye on a thick body curving down into a tail.
commentary: 虫 (chóng, insect; worm) — A snake rearing up: a triangular head with an eye on a thick body curving down into a tail. The raised triangular head on the curving body gives the creature.

depicts: A stemmed serving bowl: a wide dish on a tall flared foot, with a raised rim.
commentary: 豆 (dòu, bean; stemmed vessel) — A stemmed serving bowl: a wide dish on a tall flared foot, with a raised rim. The dish held high on its foot is the vessel.

depicts: An ear seen from the side: an outer rim, inner folds, and the ear opening.
commentary: 耳 (ěr, ear) — An ear seen from the side: an outer rim, inner folds and the ear opening. The folds inside the rim are what make it read as an ear.

depicts: A round melon hanging from a curling vine with leaves.
commentary: 瓜 (guā, melon) — A round melon hanging from a curling vine with leaves. The round fruit suspended from the vine is the melon.

depicts: One single leaf of a door — half of a double gate — with its pivot post.
commentary: 户 (hù, door; household) — One single leaf of a door — half of a double gate — with its pivot post. A single panel on its pivot is the door.

depicts: A small low table with short legs, drawn from the side.
commentary: 几 (jī, small table) — A small low table with short legs, drawn from the side. Its low top on short legs keeps it a small table.

depicts: An animal horn: thick and curved with ringed ridges along it, tapering to a point.
commentary: 角 (jiǎo, horn; corner) — An animal horn: thick and curved with ringed ridges along it, tapering to a point. The ringed ridges running along the curve are the horn's texture.

depicts: A rectangular cloth hanging down from a horizontal strap, its lower edge loose.
commentary: 巾 (jīn, cloth; towel) — A rectangular cloth hanging down from a horizontal strap, its lower edge loose. The cloth dangling from the strap is the picture.

depicts: Water gushing out of a round spring mouth in rock and streaming away below it.
commentary: 泉 (quán, spring) — Water gushing out of a round spring mouth in rock and streaming away below it. Water bursting from the rock is the spring in action.

depicts: An open umbrella from the side: a curved canopy with ribs and a straight handle below.
commentary: 伞 (sǎn, umbrella) — An open umbrella from the side: a curved canopy with ribs and a straight handle below. The ribbed canopy over the handle is the umbrella.

depicts: A bolt of lightning zigzagging down from the sky.
commentary: 申 (shēn, to state; lightning) — A bolt of lightning zigzagging down from the sky. The jagged zigzag is the lightning bolt itself.

depicts: Upper and lower molar teeth meshing together, their cusped crowns interlocked.
commentary: 牙 (yá, tooth) — Upper and lower molar teeth meshing together, their cusped crowns interlocked. The interlocking crowns show teeth built for grinding.

depicts: The ground plan of a building drawn from above: a square outline with a cross-shaped inner plan.
commentary: 亚 (yà, second; Asia) — The ground plan of a building drawn from above: a square outline with a cross-shaped inner plan. Read it as a floor plan, walls and all.

depicts: Three flat jade tablets strung together on one vertical cord.
commentary: 玉 (yù, jade) — Three flat jade tablets strung together on one vertical cord. The three tablets threaded on a single cord are the treasure.

depicts: A clan banner: a tall pole planted in a base, with long streamers flying from its top.
commentary: 中 (zhōng, middle; centre) — A clan banner: a tall pole planted in a base, with long streamers flying from its top. The pole rising through the middle, streamers flying, marks the gathering centre.

depicts: Writing slips bound into a book: vertical bamboo strips tied together by two horizontal cords.
commentary: 册 (cè, book; volume) — Writing slips bound into a book: vertical bamboo strips tied together by two horizontal cords. The cords binding the strips are what make it a book.

depicts: A broad shield with one eye peeking over its top edge.
commentary: 盾 (dùn, shield) — A broad shield with one eye peeking over its top edge. The eye above the shield shows the soldier hiding behind it.

depicts: A flayed animal hide stretched out flat: the head at the top and legs splayed at the corners.
commentary: 革 (gé, leather; hide) — A flayed animal hide stretched out flat: the head at the top and legs splayed at the corners. Stretched flat with legs at the corners, it is a hide laid out to dry.

depicts: A tiger rearing in profile: a big head with open jaws, a striped body, powerful legs and a long tail.
commentary: 虎 (hǔ, tiger) — A tiger rearing in profile: a big head with open jaws, a striped body, powerful legs and a long tail. The stripes and open jaws make the tiger fierce and clear.

depicts: A spear: a leaf-shaped spearhead mounted on a long straight shaft.
commentary: 矛 (máo, spear) — A spear: a leaf-shaped spearhead mounted on a long straight shaft. The broad leaf-shaped head on the shaft is the weapon.

depicts: A person with mouth wide open, yawning, breath rising from the mouth.
commentary: 欠 (qiàn, to yawn; to owe) — A person with mouth wide open, yawning, breath rising from the mouth. The wide-open mouth with breath rising is the yawn.

depicts: A rat in profile: pointed snout with whiskers and teeth, round ears, a plump body, little feet and a long thin tail.
commentary: 鼠 (shǔ, rat; mouse) — A rat in profile: pointed snout with whiskers and teeth, round ears, a plump body, little feet and a long thin tail. Whiskers, teeth and that long thin tail give the rat away.

depicts: A rabbit crouching in profile: long ears laid back, a round body, a short tail and folded legs.
commentary: 兔 (tù, rabbit) — A rabbit crouching in profile: long ears laid back, a round body, a short tail and folded legs. The long ears laid back over the round body are the rabbit.

depicts: A stomach: a curved sac filled with grain, sitting above a strip of flesh.
commentary: 胃 (wèi, stomach) — A stomach: a curved sac filled with grain, sitting above a strip of flesh. The grain-filled sac is the stomach shown by what it holds.

depicts: A crescent moon only half risen: the lower half of a crescent showing at dusk.
commentary: 夕 (xī, evening; sunset) — A crescent moon only half risen: the lower half of a crescent showing at dusk. Only half the moon is up — that is evening arriving.

depicts: A sharp tattooing knife standing upright on its point.
commentary: 辛 (xīn, pungent; bitter) — A sharp tattooing knife standing upright on its point. The knife balanced on its point gives the sharp, biting feel.

depicts: A seedling bending sideways as it forces its way out of the soil in spring.
commentary: 乙 (yǐ, second) — A seedling bending sideways as it forces its way out of the soil in spring. The bent little shoot is growth pushing through resistance.

depicts: Two long feathers side by side, each with a central quill and fine barbs along both sides.
commentary: 羽 (yǔ, feather) — Two long feathers side by side, each with a central quill and fine barbs along both sides. The quill down the middle with barbs fanning out is a feather's structure.

depicts: Two bamboo stalks side by side, each with pointed leaves drooping from its upper joints.
commentary: 竹 (zhú, bamboo) — Two bamboo stalks side by side, each with pointed leaves drooping from its upper joints. The drooping leaves at the joints mark the bamboo.

depicts: A round pot with a domed lid and a small knob on top, its belly swelling out.
commentary: 壶 (hú, pot; kettle) — A round pot with a domed lid and a small knob on top, its belly swelling out. The swollen belly under the lidded top is the pot.

depicts: The square wooden frame of a well seen from above: crossed timbers forming a grid over the opening.
commentary: 井 (jǐng, well) — The square wooden frame of a well seen from above: crossed timbers forming a grid over the opening. Looking down through the timber grid, you are looking into the well.

depicts: A shallow rectangular tray with bent-up sides — a frame used for raising silkworms.
commentary: 曲 (qū, bent; curved) — A shallow rectangular tray with bent-up sides — a frame used for raising silkworms. The sides bent upward give the character its bent shape.

depicts: A ladle: a small round cup with a long handle curving out of it.
commentary: 勺 (sháo, spoon; ladle) — A ladle: a small round cup with a long handle curving out of it. The little cup on its curving handle is made for scooping.

depicts: A tongue lolling out of an open mouth, its tip flicking upward.
commentary: 舌 (shé, tongue) — A tongue lolling out of an open mouth, its tip flicking upward. The tongue sticking out of the mouth is the whole picture.

depicts: A rectangular field divided by crossing paths into four plots, like a paddy seen from above.
commentary: 田 (tián, field) — A rectangular field divided by crossing paths into four plots, like a paddy seen from above. The crossing paths quartering the rectangle are the field's layout.

depicts: A crow in profile like a bird drawing — head, beak, wing, tail and feet — but with no eye dot, because the crow is too black for its eye to show.
commentary: 乌 (wū, crow) — A crow in profile like a bird drawing — head, beak, wing, tail and feet — but with no eye dot, because the crow is too black for its eye to show. The missing eye is the point.

depicts: A shallow sacrificial dish with a single drop of blood in the middle of it.
commentary: 血 (xuè, blood) — A shallow sacrificial dish with a single drop of blood in the middle of it. One drop in the dish carries the whole meaning.

depicts: A weaving shuttle: a pointed peg with thread being pushed across the warp threads.
commentary: 予 (yǔ, to give; I) — A weaving shuttle: a pointed peg with thread being pushed across the warp threads. The shuttle carrying thread across the warp is the picture.

depicts: One eye drawn upright and vertical — the eye of a head bowed low in submission.
commentary: 臣 (chén, minister; official) — One eye drawn upright and vertical — the eye of a head bowed low in submission. The turned eye shows the bowed head without drawing it.

depicts: Three long parallel streams of water flowing downward side by side.
commentary: 川 (chuān, river) — Three long parallel streams of water flowing downward side by side. Stream beside stream: the flow itself is the river.

depicts: A bronze tripod cauldron: a round belly, two handles on the rim, and three sturdy legs.
commentary: 鼎 (dǐng, tripod cauldron) — A bronze tripod cauldron: a round belly, two handles on the rim and three sturdy legs. Three legs under the round belly make it a tripod.

depicts: A strung bow: a deeply curved bow with its string drawn straight down one side.
commentary: 弓 (gōng, bow) — A strung bow: a deeply curved bow with its string drawn straight down one side. The curve of the wood against the straight string is the bow.

depicts: A standing grain plant: a stalk with leaves and a heavy drooping ear of grain at the top.
commentary: 禾 (hé, grain plant) — A standing grain plant: a stalk with leaves and a heavy drooping ear of grain at the top. The heavy ear bending the top over is the ripe grain.

depicts: A deer in profile: a head crowned with big branching antlers, a slim body and four thin legs.
commentary: 鹿 (lù, deer) — A deer in profile: a head crowned with big branching antlers, a slim body and four thin legs. The branching antlers are the first thing to look for.

depicts: An eyebrow arching over an eye: a curved brow with hair strokes, the eye below it.
commentary: 眉 (méi, eyebrow) — An eyebrow arching over an eye: a curved brow with hair strokes, the eye below it. The brow's arch over the eye is exactly what the word names.

depicts: A dog standing in profile: pointed ears, a long snout, a curled tail, and a spot marking its side.
commentary: 犬 (quǎn, dog) — A dog standing in profile: pointed ears, a long snout, a curled tail and a spot marking its side. Pointed ears, long snout and curled tail make the dog.

depicts: An arrow: a pointed metal head, a straight shaft, and feather fletching at the tail.
commentary: 矢 (shǐ, arrow) — An arrow: a pointed metal head, a straight shaft and feather fletching at the tail. Point at the front, feathers at the back — the arrow in full.

depicts: A cave dwelling: an arched mound of earth with a dark entrance opening under its roof.
commentary: 穴 (xué, cave; hole) — A cave dwelling: an arched mound of earth with a dark entrance opening under its roof. The dark opening under the arch is the cave mouth.

depicts: A boat from the side: a narrow hull with raised bow and stern and a line for its deck.
commentary: 舟 (zhōu, boat) — A boat from the side: a narrow hull with raised bow and stern and a line for its deck. The hull rising at both ends is the boat's profile.

depicts: A clawed foot pressing down: sharp talons curving out of a pad.
commentary: 爪 (zhuǎ, claw) — A clawed foot pressing down: sharp talons curving out of a pad. The talons curving downward are built for gripping.
